caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain, Choppy Seas Expected Near Antigua
caribbean.paragraph: Antigua is experiencing ESE swell with seas near 3.5 ft and a 7 s period, southeasterly winds around 14 kt, and 100% rain probability at the port. I expect Roatan to see the stronger winds to 19 kt with similar 3 to 4 ft seas, so I advise mariners and port operations to plan for reduced visibility and wet decks.

mediterranean.headline: Heavy Rain, Choppy Seas Over Western Mediterranean
mediterranean.paragraph: Lisbon is experiencing heavy rain with an 88% rain probability, winds around 14 kt and seas to 7.2 ft with a dominant NW swell at an 11 s period. Marseille is the runner-up with winds near 18 kt, and I’m watching for elevated short-period seas that could affect coastal operations and small-craft movements.
